messages.text: The best score acts strangely. A worse game can replace it, and a size I've never finished shows 0. Could you fix that and keep the rest working? Please follow the project rules.

Fixed best scores so only a lower move count replaces the saved record. Board sizes without a completed game now show `none`, including after a reload.

Type checking, all 140 unit tests, and the score persistence browser tests passed. The full browser run had one unrelated face-geometry timeout; that check passed when rerun on its own.

The repository-wide formatting check still reports three unchanged files. All files changed for this fix pass formatting.
